rules.statement: A banker who collects payment of a crossed 'not negotiable' cheque in the form of a dividend warrant indorsed by the payee with the words 'Credit my account only', and credits the proceeds to an incorrect account, is liable to pay the sum to the true owner if he acted negligently.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a crossed " not negotiable " cheque in the form of a dividend warrant is indorsed by the payee with the words " Credit my account only ", a banker who collects payment of it and credits the proceeds to the account of a person other than the true owner is liable to pay the sum to the true owner if he acted negligently in crediting the collected sum to a wrong Account.

meta.parties: De Costa v. Bank of Ceylon
